exclusion_reason: The web-native ingest is implemented: an index.html export with a WebAssembly payload routes to the web-native lane, stages only under a declared least-privilege capability manifest, and refuses any granted capability with the key surfaced. The benchmark remains red because the browser host runtime that boots the export is absent.
promotion_trigger: Promote when a declared web-native export boots in the host and the disallowed-capability case is blocked at boot.
active_gate_evidence: The security test refuses a web-native export without a manifest, stages one under the least-privilege manifest to web_native_host_pending without execution, and refuses a granted network capability.
procedure: Ingest and boot the declared web-native export.
Assert capability use stays inside the manifest.
Trigger a disallowed capability and assert the block.
pass_criterion: The export boots in the host.
